why: Run 17's window-3 claim was presented and never served, so the bond owed its holder. No agent settled it, and no agent could have been expected to: a claim minted in the last window has no later window in which settleableText would ever offer it (spec §4.6z-ii, §4.6ae), and the run-end sweep deliberately skips presented claims because a real bond draw needs a publisher-signed attestation dated the window's close day. The run's own report flagged it under holdersNeverOfferedSettlement. Settled here by hand so the holder is not left out of pocket for a gap in the harness.

attestation.note: Signed from the real published commodity print for the day the window closed, via signRateAttestationForPrint — never assembled by hand.

result.checkedBy: simulateContract before sending, then the Defaulted event and a fresh read after

doNotCountAs: agent behaviour. This settlement must not appear in any fulfilment, enforcement or holder-responsiveness statistic: it was performed by the operator precisely because the holder was never given a turn in which to perform it.
